results.title: Peachtree Corners City Map
results.description:
The Welcome to the Peachtree Corners City Map. The Web Map will assist with the process of experiencing and navigating through the city. This interactive map provides access to Geographic data depicting Election Districts, facilities, City Infrastructure, parks, playgrounds, schools, streets, trails and zoning to name few.

The mapping application also provides access to walking, biking or transit data. In addition to searching the map and neighborhoods for local addresses you can print the map using the print tool.

results.name: Chatt2kParcelsPCW22
results.title: Chatt2kParcelsPCW22
results.description:
The Chattahoochee River runs along the northern sector of the City. It is considered as a primary source of drinking for residents. All properties within the 2,000-foot Chattahoochee River Corridor are reviewed for compliance with the Metropolitan River Protection Act (MRPA). This Mapping Application was developed to depict the 2,000-foot buffer and parcels that fall within its confines.
Furthermore, the interactive mapping application provides access to a series of tools on the lower panel. The Legend and Layer List provides detail symbols for each layer. The Basemap, Measurement and Draw Tools, enable residents interact with the mapping application.

results.title: Peachtree Corners Census Analysis Demographics Phase II
results.description:
Peachtree Corners Census Analysis Demographics
The survey was conducted along the PEACHTREE CORNERS CIR intersection. The parcels in the area were selected for the survey. The parcels consisted of apartments.
 Requirements - Income, Age, Household, education, race, spending, poverty, and marital status

 Variables Specified - 2020 Median Household Income – 0 to 1,000,000

2010 Median Age – 0 to 100; 2019 HHs: Inc Below Poverty Level (ACS 5-Yr)    

2020 Total Households = numeric value 195; 2020 Pop Age 25+: High School Diploma  ; 2020 Diversity Index      70.30

2020 Annual Budget Expenditures scale   - 0 to 1,000,000

2020 Pop Age 15+: Married – Sample dataset = 44.1% of the 4,897 total population age 15 and over were married.




Peachtree Corners is organized under a council-manager form of municipal government which divides responsibilities between elected officials and an appointed city manager. Fifty-three percent (53%) of municipalities with a population between 5,000 and 249,999 residents are governed under the council-manager structure (2,903 out of 5,462).

ESRI Imagery Data Source:
 
World Imagery provides one meter or better satellite and aerial imagery in many parts of the world and lower resolution satellite imagery worldwide. The map includes 15m TerraColor imagery at small and mid-scales (~1:591M down to ~1:288k) for the world. The map features Maxar imagery at 0.3m resolution for select metropolitan areas around the world, 0.5m resolution across the United States and parts of Western Europe, and 1m resolution imagery across the rest of the world. In addition to commercial sources, the World Imagery map features high-resolution aerial photography contributed by the GIS User Community. This imagery ranges from 0.3m to 0.03m resolution (down to ~1:280 in select communities).

results.title: Community Divisions in Dubai Municipality DEMO
results.description:
This dataset gives the second level of administrative divisions within the Sectors. These administrative divisions serve the purpose of land parcel referencing. The dataset gives these divisions boundaries, ID numbers, names, etc.


For demonstration of multilingual metadata, here are a few options:

  1. Create a single item (i.e., this feature layer) and its metadata:
    Community Divisions in Dubai Municipality DEMO- use Overview > Translation to add a localized Title and Description (Abstract).

  2. Optionally, create two items (feature layer, and URL reference layer) to maintain two separate localized metadata records without duplicating the data:
    Community Divisions in Dubai Municipality DEMO
    أقسام المجتمع في بلدية دبي_DEMO– note, the URL item references the REST service of the source item

results.title: Community Divisions in Dubai Municipality_Enterprise DEMO
results.description:
This dataset gives the second level of administrative divisions within the Sectors. These administrative divisions serve the purpose of land parcel referencing. The dataset gives these divisions boundaries, ID numbers, names, etc.


For demonstration of multilingual metadata, here are a few options:

  1. Create a single item (i.e., this feature layer) and its metadata.
    In the metadata editor All tab, choose Overview > Translation to add a localized Title and Description (Abstract).

  2. Optionally, create two items (feature layer, and copy/URL reference layer) to maintain two separate localized metadata records without duplicating the data. Note, the URL item references the REST service of the source item. Overwrite the reference metadata with that of the parent, then update it in the preferred language.
